One of the most fun gameplay loops in any game I have ever played

The sense of progression is feels amazing. I got the game when commando was the only starting survivor, and struggling through the first three stages to unlock huntress, as well as any other items available, was incredibly rewarding and that is how every character unlock feels (apart from railgunner because it comes with the dlc.) The range of different play styles between the characters also keeps the game from getting boring quickly. Tired of Speed running with Loader? Try Rail Gunner: A more methodical sniper character that, with enough luck and skill, can one-shot basically any enemy in the game. Not a fan of the slow pace? Why not give Huntress a go! She can shoot while she runs and teleport a short distance. Do you enjoy the thrill of being on low health? Rex's whole kit is based around sacrificing your health to deal damage and then healing it back up. Want to focus on killing as much stuff as possible? Bandit has an ability that gets stronger every time you kill something with it.

Speaking of abilities, the game is further made more interesting by the alternate abilities each character can unlock (unless it's void fiend.) As previously mentioned, bandit has desperado, an attack that deals more damage for every kill you get with it, but this is an alternate version of Lights out, and ability that resets all your other ability cooldowns whenever you kill with it. Or, again Rex has a whole set of alternate abilities that don't try to kill you when you use them. There are obviously the best abilities to pick for each character (I don't think anyone would rather take Engineer's bubble shield over the harpoons) But these are, fro the most part, locked behind achievements, so getting the better version feels good because you are being rewarded for playing the game well.

Another thing that keeps the gameplay loop interesting is the items. Your item load-out can completely change a run. The free legendary on stage four, for example, could end up being a frost relic, encouraging you to get more up close to the enemies to kill them better, or it could be that one that multiplies all of your missiles by three, which is just broken as soon as you get atg missiles, fireworks, or even if you're playing as engineer since it also applies to the harpoons. The way items can make or break a run is incredibly frustrating, but not in a way that makes you want to quit. If I lose a run because of bad item luck, it makes me want to go back in and try again to see if I can do better.

I have more I want to say, but also it's half past midnight and i am tired so TLDR: This game has an incredibly enjoyable game play loop that keeps itself fresh through the powers of unlockables and fun RNG.

very addicting, sick maps and unique characters
would recommend
